title: Critique: estranged from the physical ultimates of science

statements.text: Panpsychism ties phenomenal properties to the physical ultimates current physics describes and so can respect the causal closure of the microphysical, while cosmopsychism seems estranged from them. Nagasawa and Wager reply that a dual-aspect cosmopsychism, with phenomenal and physical co-extensive at the level of the cosmos, could respect causal closure the same way.

sources.quote: It might be contended that priority cosmopsychism is not to be preferred since it is less
a dual-aspect version of priority cosmopsychism
